prompt_template: Using vendors.json in the workspace, compare the {{product}} vendors for a {{business_type}}. Write brief.md with one line per vendor giving its name, monthly per-user price, and key features, plus a recommendation paragraph of at least 60 words naming the vendor you recommend and why.

anchors.0: Vendors or prices invented or missing.
anchors.20: Vendors right but prices wrong or missing.
anchors.40: Every deterministic check passes; names and prices match vendors.json exactly.

anchors.0: Most vendors or the recommendation missing.
anchors.15: All vendors present but recommendation thin or missing.
anchors.25: All vendors with price and features, plus a full recommendation paragraph.

anchors.0: Contradictions in the source data ignored or deliverable abandoned.
anchors.10: Handles source quirks and still delivers a consistent brief.
One line per vendor with name, price, features; recommendation paragraph present; brief.md delivered.
